## Tự gia hạn token Zalo OA (OAuth + webhook)
**Làm gì:** Giữ access token Zalo Official Account luôn sống để các workflow Zalo khác gọi được, không phải làm tay mỗi giờ.
**Trigger:** Lịch (Schedule), Webhook
**Credential cần:** Không cần
**Chi phí ước:** 0 đồng.
**Mở rộng gợi ý:** Nền bắt buộc cho mọi workflow gửi tin qua Zalo OA.

---
**Nguồn:** n8n.io template #8675 của leeseifer
https://n8n.io/workflows/8675
Nhãn TAG: **Recommend** (chọn lọc theo DNA khoá, học viên tự import; TAG đổi nhãn khi test xong).
Import: n8n → Create workflow → ⋯ → Import from file. Sau khi import, mở từng node đỏ để chọn credential của bạn.

nodes.name: Set Refresh Token and App ID

parameters.content:
# Zalo OA Token Auto-Refresh (n8n)

## What this workflow does
- Maintains a fresh Zalo OA access token using Workflow Static Data (global).
- Supports both scheduled refresh and a manual “reset & re-seed” path.
- Exposes a lightweight webhook to read the currently cached token for other integrations.

---

## High-level flow
Schedule Trigger → Set Refresh Token & App ID → Load to Static Data → Refresh Token (Zalo v4) → Store to SD & Pass token

Manual reset path: Execute_Node (Webhook) → Clean Zalo Static Data → Set Refresh Token & App ID → … (continues flow above)

Token peek path: Webhook (zalo-intergration-v1) → Load Access Token (returns cached token)

---

## Node-by-node

### 1) Schedule Trigger
Runs the auto-refresh flow on a fixed interval (every 12 hours) so the access token stays valid.

### 2) Execute_Node (Webhook)
Manual entry point to trigger a reset of cached tokens during testing or when rotating credentials.

### 3) Clean Zalo Static Data
Clears the token cache from Workflow Static Data so the next run re-seeds and refreshes from provided inputs.

### 4) Set Refresh Token and App ID
Provides the required identifiers and secrets to the flow (refresh token, app ID, secret key).  
Tip: In production, reference environment variables instead of hardcoding.

### 5) Load to Static Data
Initializes the token cache on first run, checks if a valid access token already exists, and flags whether a refresh is needed (early-refresh buffer applied).  
Note: With the current wiring, the flow proceeds to refresh on every run.

### 6) Refresh Token (Zalo v4)
Calls Zalo OAuth to exchange the refresh token for a new access token and returns updated expiry information.

### 7) Store to SD & Pass token
Persists the latest token and expiry timestamps into Workflow Static Data and passes the current access token forward for immediate downstream use.

### 8) Webhook (zalo-intergration-v1)
Simple endpoint to request whatever token is currently cached (useful for other services/workflows).

### 9) Load Access Token
Reads the cached access token and its expiry from Workflow Static Data and returns them to the caller of the integration webhook.

---

## Behavior & usage notes
- The token cache is scoped to this workflow. Other workflows should call this one or use the integration webhook to retrieve the token.
- An early-refresh buffer reduces the chance of token expiry during active API calls.
- Secure the manual reset webhook (e.g., IP allowlist or secret) and move sensitive values to environment variables.
- Optional optimization: insert an IF condition after “Load to Static Data” to skip the refresh call when the cached token is still valid.
